v08-la-gamba.name: La Gamba
tags: The Cuadrat family since 1967, in a former fish depot — the prawn temple of Palamós
v08-la-gamba.why: The Cuadrat family since 1967, in a former fish depot — the prawn temple of Palamós. To order: gamba de Palamós (the star, simply grilled); arròs with prawn; whatever's fresh off the auction. Order the Palamós prawn here first, and nowhere else.

v10-rafa-s.name: Rafa's
tags: A ~5-table counter beloved by Ferran Adrià and the elBulli crew; no printed menu
Early lunch; closed parts of the week
v10-rafa-s.why: A ~5-table counter beloved by Ferran Adrià and the elBulli crew; no printed menu. To order: grilled red prawns of Roses; house anchovies with tomato and toast; espardenyes (sea cucumbers); oysters and clams off the planxa. A pilgrimage for purists — fish, salt, olive oil, nothing else.
v10-rafa-s.hours: Early lunch; closed parts of the week

v09-cal-tet.name: Cal Tet
tags: Long-running family marisqueria/hostal — the go-to for the catch off the Illes Medes
v09-cal-tet.why: Long-running family marisqueria/hostal — the go-to for the catch off the Illes Medes. To order: suquet de peix; rice with local fish and shellfish; whole grilled fish of the day. Honest Medes-coast seafood without the resort markup.
v09-cal-tet.address: Carrer de Santa Anna 38, 17258 L'Estartit (Torroella de Montgrí)

v12-espai-del-peix-llotja-de-palam-s.name: Espai del Peix / Llotja de Palamós
tags: Working fish auction; the interpretation centre runs guided auction visits and show-cooking on the same quay
Late afternoon for the live auction
v12-espai-del-peix-llotja-de-palam-s.why: Working fish auction; the interpretation centre runs guided auction visits and show-cooking on the same quay. To order: book the afternoon auction visit + tasting (the prawn straight off the boats). See the gamba de Palamós sold at the descending Dutch auction before it ever hits a plate.
v12-espai-del-peix-llotja-de-palam-s.address: Edifici de la Llotja, Moll Pesquer s/n, 17230 Palamós
v12-espai-del-peix-llotja-de-palam-s.hours: Late afternoon for the live auction
v12-espai-del-peix-llotja-de-palam-s._lane: The market, the auction, the salt

v13-anxoves-sol-s.name: Anxoves Solés
tags: L'Escala anchovy house, 1888 lineage, five generations; the heritage name
Daytime; pair with a visit to a factory-museum
v13-anxoves-sol-s.why: L'Escala anchovy house, 1888 lineage, five generations; the heritage name. To order: salt-cured anchovy fillets in olive oil; whole salted anchovies; seitons (boquerones). The definitive Empordà larder souvenir; the other historic house, Anxoves de l'Escala, is nearby.
v13-anxoves-sol-s.hours: Daytime; pair with a visit to a factory-museum
v13-anxoves-sol-s._lane: The market, the auction, the salt

v11-mercat-del-lle.name: Mercat del Lleó
tags: Girona's historic covered market (1944), ~60 stalls; where the city's chefs shop
v11-mercat-del-lle.why: Girona's historic covered market (1944), ~60 stalls; where the city's chefs shop. To order: seasonal bolets (wild mushrooms); local embotits (botifarra, fuet); Empordà cheeses; Roses and Palamós fish at the stalls. Start any Girona food day here.
v11-mercat-del-lle.address: Plaça de Francesc Calvet i Rubalcaba, 17002 Girona
v11-mercat-del-lle._lane: The market, the auction, the salt

v14-la-tabarra.name: La Tabarra
tags: Old-Town wine bar with a strong DO Empordà list and a terrace on the medieval Força
v14-la-tabarra.why: Old-Town wine bar with a strong DO Empordà list and a terrace on the medieval Força. To order: a flight of DO Empordà reds and whites; the fried-prawn brioche; small plates. The easiest way to drink the Empordà by the glass in the Old Town.
v14-la-tabarra._lane: Le Bar — Girona's old town by the glass, the cup and the cone

v15-la-f-brica.name: La Fábrica
tags: Girona's pioneering specialty café, run by a pro cyclist and his wife — the cycling community's clubhouse
v15-la-f-brica.why: Girona's pioneering specialty café, run by a pro cyclist and his wife — the cycling community's clubhouse. To order: flat white or single-origin filter; the brunch plates (eggs, avocado, local produce). Where Girona's pro-cyclist scene fuels up — the coffee is the real reason.
v15-la-f-brica._lane: Le Bar — Girona's old town by the glass, the cup and the cone

v16-rocambolesc.name: Rocambolesc
tags: Jordi Roca's playful gelateria (opened 2012) — the Roca-universe sweet spot you can walk into
v16-rocambolesc.why: Jordi Roca's playful gelateria (opened 2012) — the Roca-universe sweet spot you can walk into. To order: the panet (gelato in brioche); the soft-serve with toppings; seasonal Roca flavours. The most accessible taste of the Roca brothers — no months-ahead booking required.
v16-rocambolesc._lane: Le Bar — Girona's old town by the glass, the cup and the cone
